EU|185944|Individual.name: Сергей Александрович БАШКОВ
EU|185944|Individual.remarks: Sergey Bashkov is the director of Limited Liability Company (LLC) Irz-Svyaz. The company is part of the Russian arms industry, which is a sector of strategic importance to the Russian Federation.LLC Irz-Svyaz is a Russian manufacturer of communication systems that perform the function of switching, mostly for navigation receivers. LLC Irz-Svyaz has licenses for production and repair of weapons and military equipment. The company also supplies components to the military and industrial complex of the Russian Federation, as its manufactured products are used in UAV’s Orlan-10 and Tachion, which are used by Russian armed forces in Ukraine. LLC Irz-Svyaz also sells its manufactured goods to Russian military and industrial complex companies, such as JSC Votokinsk Plant, a known manufacturer of Iskander-M ballistic missiles. Moreover, LLC Irz-Svyaz is a systemically important company in Russia in the field of manufacturing navigation receivers for GPS and for GLONASS, which is a Russian satellite navigation system designed for operational navigation and time support for an unlimited number of land, sea, air and space-based users.Therefore, Sergey Bashkov is materially supporting Russia’s military and industrial complex, including by being involved in the development, production or supply of military technology and equipment.
